s: Zeman teqiat shopar ubo t' seipim: zeman teqiat shopar bayyom, shenneemar "yom terua vego'" — bayyom velo ballayla. Vekol hayyom kasher litqiat shopar mealot hashshachar ad tzet hakkokabim, ella shechakamim hitzriku lehamtin ad shettanetz hachamma sheyyatza mikkelal sepeq layla, sheen hakkol beqiin beammud hashshachar. Umikkol maqom im abar vetaqa mishsheala ammud hashshachar qodem hanetz hachamma — yatza, veen tzarik litqoa shenit:
Im shama miqtzat teqia qodem ammud hashshachar umiqtzatah achar ammud hashshachar — nitbaer besiman tqp"z:
Shama tesha teqiot betesha shaot bayyom o mittesha bene adam shettaqeu keechad — nitbaer besiman tq"tz:

Yom tob shel rosh hashshana shechal lihyot beshabbat — en toqein bashshopar, ap al pi shehatteqia bashshopar enah melaka veenah asura beshabbat veyom tob ella middibre soperim, mishshum ubdin dechol. Velama en dochin issur qal kazeh mippene mitzvat aseh shel tora kemo sheddochin oto bekol yom tob shel rosh hashshana hoil veen bo shebut gamur, lepi shehakkol chayyabin bitqiat shopar veen hakkol beqiin bitqiat shopar gezera shemma yittelennu beyado veyelek etzel habbaqi lilmod veyaabirennu d' ammot birshut harabbim:

Vedin tiltul hashshopar beshabbat zo kedin tiltulo bekol shabbetot hashshana, sheen metaltelin oto ki im letzorek meqomo o letzorek gupo, dehaynu lismok bo et haqqeara ukayyotze bazeh. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beshabbat, abal im chal bechol ap al pi shemmuttar letaltelo apillu shello letzorek gupo umeqomo kevan shettoqein bo bayyom, vedino kikli shemmelakto lehetter shennitbaer besiman sh"ch, mikkol maqom asur lehishtammesh bo velehanot mimmennu bo bayyom kegon lismok bo et haqqeara vekayyotze bazeh, shehare huqtza lemitzvato, ukemo sheyyitbaer besiman trs"h, ayyen sham:

Qatan hattoqea beshabbat zo — bet din metzuvvin lehaprisho ap al pi shello higgia lechinnuk kemo shennitbaer besiman shm"g, ayyen sham. (Ap al pi sheiqqar mitzvat shemiat shopar hi shemiat qolo bilbad, mikkol maqom) im hattoqea hu patur mimmitzva zo — eno motzi acherim yede chobatan bitqiato. Veellu hen happeturim: nashim vaabadim mippene shehi mitzvat aseh shehazzeman gerama, vecheresh veshoteh veqatan ap al pi shehiggia lechinnuk eno motzi et haggedolim yede chobatan shechayyabim min hattora:

Cheresh hashshomea veeno medabber hare hu kepiqqeach vechayyab bitqiat shopar, ulepikak hu motzi acherim yede chobatan, veechad mehashshomein mebarek vehu toqea. Abal hamdabber veeno shomea eno motzi, dekevan deeno shomea lav bar chiyyuba hu, deen hammitzva batteqia ella bashshemia:

Suma chayyab bitqiat shopar. Veim haya muchzaq litqoa bekol shana vesillequhu mippene shechasheshu ledibre haomer desuma patur mikkol hammitzvot haamurot battora, im en baqi bitqia kamohu — yachaziruhu leminnuyo, abal lekattechilla en lesalleqo ap al pi shennimtza baqi kamohu, lepi shehaiqqar etzlenu desuma chayyab bekol hammitzvot haamurot battora:

Tumtum veanderoginos en chayyabin ella missapeq shemma hen zekarim, lepikak enan motziin et acherim shechayyabim bevadday, abal motzi hu haanderoginos et haanderoginos kemoto sheeno chayyab ella missapeq, abal eno motzi et hattumtum, vaapillu tumtum kemoto eno motzi ap al pi sheshshenehem sapeq, deshemma liksheyyiqqara tumtum zeh yimmatze zakar velikshettiqqara zo timmatze neqeba:
